description: Implement Node.js signaling server with Express, Socket.io, and Firebase Auth. Includes user presence tracking, call state machine, SDP/ICE candidate relay, and Firebase Firestore integration for users/contacts/calls collections. This is the core backend; mobile and web apps depend on it.
steps: Create /server/src/index.js: Express app with Socket.io, HTTPS setup, middleware (cors, rate-limit), Firebase Admin SDK initialization, routes registration
Create /server/src/middleware/auth.js: Firebase token verification middleware; exports verifyToken(token) returning uid or throwing error
Create /server/src/services/firebase.js: Firestore DB instance and CRUD helpers for users (create, getByUsername, getById), contacts (add, getList, respond), calls (create, update, getHistory)

Create /server/src/services/signaling.js: Socket.io event handlers for auth, call:request, call:accept, call:reject, call:end, webrtc:offer, webrtc:answer, webrtc:ice; maintains in-memory user presence map and call state
Create /server/src/services/turn.js: Function issueTurnCredentials(uid, callId) returning { username, credential, iceServers } with time-limited TURN password (valid 1 hour per spec §3.6)
Create /server/src/services/push.js: FCM/APNs push notification sender; exports sendIncomingCallPush(fcmToken, callerName, callId) — scaffold APNs code with comment 'requires Apple Developer account'

Create /server/src/routes/users.js: POST /api/users/username (set/validate username), GET /api/users/search?username= (exact match search), returns user profile with uid, username, displayName only (no email per §3.6)
Create /server/src/routes/calls.js: GET /api/calls/history?limit=20&offset=0 (paginated), records stored in Firestore calls collection
Create /server/src/routes/turn.js: GET /api/turn-credentials returns time-limited credentials via issueTurnCredentials()
Create /server/src/validation.js: Zod schemas for username (3-20 chars, lowercase), call payload (callId UUID, toUsername), offer/answer/ice payloads; reusable in routes and signaling
Create /server/.env.example with: PORT, NODE_ENV, FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL, TURN_REALM, TURN_SECRET, TURN_HOST, FCM_SERVER_KEY, SIGNALING_SERVER_URL
Create /server/package.json scripts: start (node src/index.js), dev (nodemon src/index.js), build (tsc or skip if no TS), test (jest --coverage)

Implement error handling in all socket events and routes: invalid tokens return auth:error, missing fields return validation error, offline user returns call:unavailable, rate-limit exceeded returns 429
acceptance_criteria: Socket connection succeeds with valid Firebase token and fails with invalid/missing token
call:request to online user triggers call:incoming event on callee socket
call:accept sends call:accepted event back to caller
SDP offer/answer and ICE candidates relay correctly between peers through the server
Rate limiting prevents spam: calling same user 5+ times in 1 minute returns error
GET /api/users/search?username=bob returns { uid, username, displayName } (no email)
POST /api/contacts/request creates pending contact record in Firestore
GET /api/turn-credentials returns { username, credential, iceServers } with TURN server URL
Presence tracking: online contacts show 'online' in their presence:update event; offline contacts don't
Call history records in Firestore with callId, callerUid, calleeUid, startedAt, answeredAt, endedAt, durationSec
verification: Run: cd server && npm test — expect Jest to pass all unit tests for signaling handlers, Firebase operations, validation
Run: cd server && npm run dev (in background) — expect 'Listening on port 3001' (or configured port)
Integration test: connect two Socket.io clients with valid tokens, call:request -> call:incoming -> call:accept -> call:accepted flow completes without errors (manual or automated)
Test offline callee: send call:request to non-existent/offline username, expect call:unavailable event within 2 seconds
Test rate limit: send 6 call:request events to same user within 60 seconds, expect 6th to return error
Test TURN endpoint: GET /api/turn-credentials with valid token returns valid credential object with 1-hour expiry
Query Firestore: call history entries exist for completed calls with correct timestamps and durations
findings: IMPLEMENTATION COMPLETE. Test Results: 20 unit tests passed (validation schemas, TURN credential generation). Server startup verified on localhost:3001. CONFIGURATION NOTES: (1) Firebase initialization gracefully handles missing credentials; in production, set FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID, FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY, FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL in .env. Without valid Firebase credentials, Firestore operations will fail, but server will start for development. (2) Socket.io signaling implements all required event handlers per spec §3.3: auth, call:request with 5-call-per-60sec rate limiting, call:accept/reject/end, webrtc:offer/answer/ice candidate relay. (3) In-memory user presence map tracks online users; broadcasts presence:update events on connect/disconnect. (4) TURN credentials use 1-hour expiry per spec §3.6. (5) Email never exposed in user search (returns only uid, username, displayName). (6) Integration tests require valid Firebase credentials and manual Socket.io client connections for full flow verification. KNOWN LIMITATIONS: APNs scaffold code only; requires Apple Developer account for production. Rate limiting uses in-memory store (not persisted across server restarts).
